column1: # p286 — `pass257-restriction-scan`'s VOCABULARY IS ENGLISH-ONLY, AND ITS MISS REPORTS AS
# "NO RESTRICTION" RATHER THAN "CANNOT READ".  Reproduced, not inferred: both rows below are
# `restriction_scan.scan()` output on this pass's own payloads.
# 🔴 The consequence is the dangerous direction: a body whose section 3 is titled
# `LARANGAN PENGGUNAAN KOMERSIAL` ("PROHIBITION OF COMMERCIAL USE") is published as carrying
# no restriction at all.  `lib/license_family.sh` already carries 38 non-English grant-title
# tokens (`licenca publica geral` and kin), so the base KNOWS grants arrive in other
# languages in the TITLE channel -- the RESTRICTION channel never inherited it.  That is
# p282's shape exactly: a class established in one instrument and not in the one beside it.

column5: 🔴 TOTAL commercial prohibition in section 3, plus a section-5 asset-scope split and a section-6 Feather-Icons MIT carve-out. NONE of it read

column1: English control ("NonCommercial ... Commercial use is prohibited")
